title: 第28章 天！功！真！战！兵！
novel_title: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
content_zh:
身为圣宝楼的接待，池悦白很有耐心，介绍道：

    “修士之间的搏杀，除却自身境界外，千万年归纳总结下来，无非天、功、真、战、兵五种。”

    “最简单的兵便是指宝器，不入阶的宝器三百枚源石，也能增幅修士八九成战力。”

    “战法其次，最差的战法《莽牛拳》修至圆满，也能发挥出超越同境一倍的实力。”

    “真意图太珍贵，圣宗也唯有内门有机会，月余前拍卖的一副《极炎真图》五十三万源石，具体是何品阶我不清楚。”

    说到真意图，池悦白忍不住向上看去，摇头叹息。

    绝大部分修士，这辈子都没有机会接触到真意图。

    “功便是踏入修行的根本功法，划分为经，功，法，诀四个层次，根据法门不同，各有不同神异，传闻圣宗两大镇宗经意，修至圆满，可强于同境九倍战力。”

    “天便是天资道基，后天弥补天资道基的法门称作天功，任何天功修至圆满，实力都是普通同境数倍。”

    一边说着，池悦白还转动幻影柜，诸如刀枪剑戟种种宝器，还有一块块玉简闪烁其中。

    标记着《长青呼吸法》、《蛮牛拳》、《神行腿》、《柔水天功》....等诸多法门。

    沈云看到，最便宜的法门也是带着好几个零，单价还是源石。

    这么多零，他只在....见过。

    最便宜的《蛮牛拳》都需要五百枚源石。

    握了握手中四十五枚源石，五种能够提升战力的方法。

    沈云发现自己一个都买不起。

    天功最让沈云动心，竟然能弥补资质，他这一三道基竟然能后天弥补。

    不过那价格是零最长的，属实不是他这个阶段所能想，珍贵无比。

    “天、功、真、战、兵是怎么提升战力的呢？”

    沈云很不解，战力也能量化吗？

    这应该和实力，技巧，环境等方方面面都有关系吧。

    “对于我们养体境而言，最直观的便是能够增加力气，圆满的《莽牛拳》增加一倍力气；宝器中注入气血，也能增加一倍力气。”

    这些不是什么珍贵的知识，池悦白随口就说了出来。

    她更可以确定，眼前的这个客人不属于任何大势力，纯散修小白。

    “增加力道！”

    沈云没想到这么简单粗暴，不过他确实感觉运转呼吸法时候，力道会有所增长。

    这不是错觉。

    “这么多提升实力的方式，还会有普通同阶吗？”

    刚问完，结果那池悦白转身幽幽看向了他。

    沈云恍然，自己这种什么都没有的，站在同境最底端。

    不对！

    他呼吸法小成，经，功，法，诀中‘法’还能排第三。

    另外《滚石拳》也到了小成，不应该是最菜的那个。

    沈云自信的对视了回去。

    “蛮荒未开灵智的普通蛮兽，比同境只修功法的普通修士稍强一些，若是修士修行基础的功法和战法，则能够力压普通蛮兽。”

    池悦白连忙开口。

    沈云点了点头，心里大概有数了。
content_en:
As the receptionist of Shengbao Tower, Chi Yuebai was very patient and introduced:

    "The fighting between monks, apart from their own realm, can be summed up over thousands of years, and there are only five types: heaven, gong, truth, war, and soldiers."

    "The simplest weapon is a treasure weapon. Three hundred source stones for a non-level treasure weapon can increase a monk's combat power by 80 to 90%."

    "The next best thing is the tactics. The worst tactics, "Rang Niu Fist", can be practiced to perfection, and you can exert twice as much strength as those in the same realm."

    "The true intention is too precious. Only the inner sect of the Holy Sect has a chance. The "True Picture of Extreme Flame" that was auctioned more than a month ago has 530,000 source stones. I don't know what grade it is."

    Speaking of true intentions, Chi Yuebai couldn't help but look up, shook his head and sighed.

    Most monks will never have the opportunity to come into contact with true intentions in this life.

    "Gong is the fundamental method for practicing cultivation. It is divided into four levels: Sutra, Gong, Dharma, and Jue. According to different methods, each has its own magic. It is said that the two major sect-suppressing scriptures of the Holy Sect, when cultivated to perfection, can be nine times stronger than those in the same realm."

    "Heaven is the foundation of natural talent. The method of making up for the foundation of natural talent the day after tomorrow is called heavenly power. When any heavenly power is perfected, the strength will be several times that of ordinary people in the same realm."

    While speaking, Chi Yuebai also turned the phantom cabinet, with various treasures such as swords, guns, swords and halberds, and pieces of jade slips shining in it.

    Marked with "Evergreen Breathing Technique", "Barbarian Bull Boxing", "Magic Kick", "Rou Shui Tian Kung"... and many other techniques.

    Shen Yun saw that the cheapest method also had several zeros, and the unit price was still Source Stone.

    He had only seen so many zeros in...

    The cheapest version of "Barbarian Bull Fist" requires 500 Origin Stones.

    Holding the forty-five Origin Stones in his hand, there are five ways to increase combat power.

    Shen Yun found that he couldn't afford any of them.

    What attracted Chen Yun the most was that Heavenly Skill could make up for his aptitude, and that his three foundations could make up for it the day after tomorrow.

    However, the price is zero for the longest time. It is really beyond what he can imagine at this stage. It is extremely precious.

    "How do Heaven, Gong, Zhen, Zhan, and Bing increase combat power?"

    Shen Yun was puzzled. Can combat power be quantified?

    This should have something to do with strength, skills, environment and other aspects.

    "For us in the realm of body cultivation, the most intuitive thing is that it can increase strength. The perfect "Rang Niu Fist" can double the strength; injecting qi and blood into the treasure can also double the strength."

    This is not precious knowledge, Chi Yuebai said it casually.

    She was even more certain that the customer in front of her did not belong to any major force, but was a pure novice cultivator.

    "Increase strength!"

    Shen Yun didn't expect it to be so simple and crude, but he did feel that when he used the breathing method, his strength would increase.

    This is not an illusion.

    "With so many ways to improve strength, will there still be ordinary ones of the same level?"

    Just after he asked, Chi Yuebai turned around and looked at him quietly.

    Chen Yun suddenly realized that he, who had nothing, was standing at the bottom of the same situation.

    wrong!

    He has a small degree of success in the breathing method, and among the sutras, skills, methods, and techniques, the 'method' can still be ranked third.

    In addition, "Rolling Stone" has also reached a small level of success, so it shouldn't be the weakest one.

    Shen Yun looked back confidently.

    "Ordinary savage beasts in the wilderness who have not yet developed their spiritual intelligence are slightly stronger than ordinary monks in the same realm who only practice Kung Fu. If the monks practice basic Kung Fu and warfare, they can overwhelm ordinary savages."

    Chi Yuebai spoke quickly.

    Chen Yun nodded, probably knowing it well.
